snippet.title: We Took That Trip | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
Hit the road and try the demo on Steam ➤ https://store.steampowered.com/app/1754250/We_Took_That_Trip/

A cozy road trip adventure about friendship, loss, and reunion.
Wake up on a quiet beach. Turn the key. Let the engine hum. It’s just you, your van, your cat, and an endless road stretching into ever-changing, procedurally generated landscapes.

No timers. No saving the world. Just the journey.
